paite: Akha sagihna, huai kha ani sawmnih-le-khatna in, zawlnei Haggai a kipan TOUPA thu ahong tung hi:
heading: Tempul Thak Thupina
english: In the seventh month, in the twenty-first day of the month, the Word of Yahweh came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

paite: "Judah ukpipa Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel kiang ah leh siampu lian, Jehozadak tapa Joshua kiang leh mikhosuaksunte kiang ah tu'n thu gen in," chi in.
english: “Speak now to Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

paite: Tuma a athupina a hiai inn mu, na lak uah kua na om lai ua? Huan tu in bangchibang in na mu ua? Na mitmuh un bangmah lou bang ahi maw? chi in.
english: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How do you see it now? Isn’t it in your eyes as nothing?

paite: Himahleh, Zerubbabel aw, hattak in om in, TOUPA'N achi, Joshua, siampu lian, Jehozadak tapa aw, hattak in om in; nou gam a mite tengteng aw, hattak in om unla, nna sem un, TOUPA'N achi; na kiang ua ka om ziak in, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says Yahweh. ‘Be strong, Joshua, son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ says Yahweh, ‘and work, for I am with you,’ says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan a na hong paikhiak lai ua na kiang ua thu ka khun a, na lak ua ka kha a-om gige dan theigige un; lau kei un.
english: This is the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, and my Spirit lived among you. ‘Don’t be afraid.’

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi ngal a: Khatvei lai, sawt lou kal in, vante, leitung leh tuipi, gamhulte tan in ka sing ding hi.
english: For this is what Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the dry land;

paite: Nam tengteng ka sing ding a, huchi in nam tengteng thil deihte ahong tung ding, huchi in thupina in hiai inn ka dimsak ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: and I will shake all nations. The precious things of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Dangka kei a ahi, dangka-eng kei a ahi, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine,’ says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Hiai inn thupina nanung, amasa sang in athupizaw ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: hiai lai mun ah muanna ka pe ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says Yahweh of Armies; ‘and in this place will I give peace,’ says Yahweh of Armies.”

paite: Darias akum nihna, akha kuana ani sawmnih-le-lina in, zawlnei Haggai a kipan in TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
heading: Ginomlouhna Gawtnate
english: In the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the Word of Yahweh came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Tu in dan lam thu a siampute dong un;
english: “Thus says Yahweh of Armies: Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,

paite: mi'n apuansilh puanten ah sa siangthou lou leh apuanten in tanghou hiam, meh hiam, uain hiam, sa hiam sukha taleh, siangthou ahi lai diam?" chi in. Siampute'n, "li" chi in adawng uhi.
english: ‘If someone carries holy meat in the fold of his garment, and with his fold touches bread, stew, wine, oil, or any food, will it become holy?’” The priests answered, “No.”

paite: Haggai in, "Misi luang ziak a minin in hiaite abangpeuh khoih kha taleh siang in a-om diam?" achi hi. Siampute'n adawng ua, "Siang lou in a-om ding," achi uhi.
english: Then Haggai said, “If one who is unclean by reason of a dead body touch any of these, will it be unclean?” The priests answered, “It will be unclean.”

paite: Haggai in adawng a, "TOUPA'N, huchibang in hiai mite leh huchibang in hiai nam ka ma ah ahi uh; huchibang in akhutte uh nasep chiteng; leh huai lai a athillat uh asiang kei, achi,” chi in.
english: Then Haggai answered, “‘So is this people, and so is this nation before me,’ says Yahweh; ‘and so is every work of their hands. That which they offer there is unclean.

paite: Huchi in tu in, ka hon ngen ahi, tuni a kipan leh abanban in, TOUPA tempul a suang akichian ma in ngaihtuah un;
heading: TOUPA'N Vualzawlna Achiam
english: Now, please consider from this day and backward, before a stone was laid on a stone in Yahweh’s temple.

paite: mi'n tehna sawmnih kivum ahong muh lai, huai nite a-om nungsiah, sawmkhat kia a-om hi; bawm sawmnga a dimkhe ding a mi'n uain thau ahon muh lai in, sawmnih kia a-om hi.
english: Through all that time, when one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When one came to the wine vat to draw out fifty, there were only twenty.

paite: Na khut nasepte tengteng uah keuna leh kawt luatna leh gial in ka hon gawt a; huchipi in leng kei lam na hong nga kei uh, TOUPA'N achi.
english: I struck you with blight, mildew, and hail in all the work of your hands; yet you didn’t turn to me,’ says Yahweh.

paite: Tuni a kipan leh abanban in ngaihtuah un, TOUPA tempul suangphum akiphum ni a kipan, akha kuana ani sawmnih-le-li ni a kipan, ngaihtuah un.
english: ‘Consider, please, from this day and backward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, since the day that the foundation of Yahweh’s temple was laid, consider it.

paite: Buhpang ah haichi a-om lai hia? Ahi, grepgui, theipi kung, theibuhfai, olive sing ahong suak kei lai a; tuni a kipan in ka hon vualzawl ding hi.
english: Is the seed yet in the barn? Yes, the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree haven’t brought forth. From this day will I bless you.’”

paite: Huai kha ani sawmnih-le-li ni in Haggai kiang ah anihveina in TOUPA thu ahong tung hi:
heading: Zerubbabel Kiang A TOUPA Thuchiam
english: The Word of Yahweh came the second time to Haggai in the twenty-fourth day of the month, saying,

paite: Judah ukpipa Zerubbabel kiang ah, "Van leh lei ka sing ding a,
english: “Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, ‘I will shake the heavens and the earth.

paite: lalgam leh laltutphahte ka lumlet ding a, namte, lalgamte hatna ka hihse ding a, kangtalaite leh huai a tuangte ka pai ding; huchi in sakolte leh atung ua tuang mite ahong kum ding uh, michih a-unau namsau in satlum ding achi, chi in thu gen in.
english: I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms. I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations. I will overthrow the chariots, and those who ride in them. The horses and their riders will come down, everyone by the sword of his brother.

paite: Huai ni chiang in, Aw Zerubbabel, ka sikha, Shealtiel tapa, ka hon la ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, suainamna in ka hon bawl ding, TOUPA'N, achi; nang ka hon telta ngal a," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: In that day, says Yahweh of Armies, will I take you, Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel,’ says Yahweh, ‘and will make you as a signet, for I have chosen you,’ says Yahweh of Armies.”
